summary: This bill makes permanent a provision in the Internal Revenue Code that allows employers to make tax-free payments towards their employees' student loans as part of an educational assistance program.

scores.thoughts: This bill makes permanent an exclusion from income for certain employer payments of student loans. This effectively lowers the tax burden for individuals receiving such payments and for employers providing them, as these payments would otherwise be taxable income.

The bill permanently extends the tax exclusion under IRC Section 127 for employer payments of employee student loans, forgoing revenue that would otherwise be collected after 2025. This is the sole purpose of the legislation and directly increases the federal deficit.
